description: Delete one of the account's images, models, audio files, Blender models (kind blender: a whole uploaded .blend with every version; its meshes in use stay) or texture sets (kind textureSet: the set and its maps, r3_texture_create made it) — the same reference-guarded delete as the R3 app. With asset:delete:created, only an asset YOU created (this agent key or app connection; today: images made with r3_image_create); with asset:delete:owned, any of the user's assets, and only when the user asked for it: pass owned: true for one you did not create (an app connection is then asked for that right). ALWAYS two calls: first without `confirm` — nothing is deleted, the answer says what would go and which of the user's projects use it; then, if that is what the user wants, the same call with `confirm: true`. An asset another user's project uses can never be deleted. A model takes the images only it used with it, an HDR / EXR image its preview image. There is no trash and no undo. Find ids with r3_image_list, r3_audio_list and r3_blender_list.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call (it only reports). true deletes — after the user has seen the report.

deleteReleases.description: With confirm: also move the user's non-live, UNPINNED releases that use it to the 7-day trash (needs release:delete; only when the user asked). Without it those releases are kept: for an image, model or audio file they are marked incomplete; for a Blender model they keep their meshes (the meshes they use stay). Pinned releases are never deleted by an agent.

id.description: The asset's id, as the list tools report it.

kind.description: What the id names: blender = a Blender model (its blenderModelId), textureSet = a texture set (its setId).

owned.description: true when the asset is one of the user's own, not one you created: it needs asset:delete:owned. Only when the user asked to delete it. Leave out for an asset you created.

name: r3_asset_delete

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Delete an image, model, audio file or Blender model
